title: Selecting "Use percent values" for the Incomes by Articles report causes the app to crash

full_report.title: Selecting "Use percent values" for the Incomes by Articles report causes the app to crash
full_report.observed_behavior: On the Display of Incomes by Articles dialog, if the user taps the "Use percent values" checkbox, the application crashes.
full_report.expected_behavior: The application should change the report appearance to use percent values without crashing.
full_report.steps_to_reproduce:
1. Open the app. <24f7aef009bd7a8b145fd2acabd46d79833f775339f82b7248b75b22eb407522>
2. On the initial permission screen, tap "DENY". <2b209a3d55050bc8611e4799d186aac1ed51a780062d43e781082427e0523b10>
3. On the dashboard, tap "Reports". <9a4f389ec16dc06bc51519fd35159ab49c667d2cae3e0323df9bf08cd98bda88>
4. On the Reports screen, open "Incomes by Articles". <c010db1badf9deb0564b10c46916ad505c7d1acca0f840fdc12c4867c81990d0>
5. On the Incomes by Articles report screen, tap "Display". <c7c181b4d07f85b6731edefa0c51eca8637b088e992c8d07e2349379db3cd413>
6. In the display dialog, tap "Use percent values". <c3292f1abb084883da9f0bf06776dd33343b186505d53bedfbb8b83717e4b319>
7. Tap "OK" to confirm the change. <26c0ae2d76021672cf80c07928394773aec07f5be831f91ab09b5f7c2392b6aa>

ground_truth.info_elements_gt:
Buggy Behavior: the application crashes
Triggering GUI Interaction: changes the appearance of the report from 'view values' to use percent values'
Triggering Screen Reference: Display of Incomes by Articles pop-up of the Reports screen
Correct Behavior: The appearance of the report should be changed to 'use percent values'
